title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A default only the tests could see
summary: A setting read as get(key, fallback) never returns that fallback once the key is declared in package.json. The test stub does return it, so a fallback that disagrees with the declared default is a value only the tests ever see.

highlights.title: One reading, one default
highlights.description: The Room migration check read the indexed file ceiling with a fallback of 3000 where the declared default is 10000.

highlights.title: A guard over all 135 calls
highlights.description: Every setting read with a literal fallback is now checked against package.json, so the two cannot drift apart again.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: The Room migration check now reads the indexed file ceiling the same way as every other consumer.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: Nothing changes for anyone running a released build: the declared default was already the value in force.
